zh_CN.title: 墨刻·本能数据表盘｜光照强度·心率·省电
zh_CN.description:
黑白分明、一眼看清的数据表盘。所有字体按手表屏幕的像素网格逐个绘制，大字时间锐利，小字也清楚。免费，无广告、无订阅。

• 省电设计：不开 GPS、不联网、不用后台定时器，屏幕上没显示的数据一项也不读；默认省电刷新（趋势图 5 分钟、天气 30 分钟），秒数和心率刷新还能再调低。
• 6 种大时间字体：当前数字、简洁黑体、窄体数字、方角数字、数码管、点阵，手表上或手机里一键切换。
• 29 种数据、94 项设置：每个数据位都能换数据、换显示方式、换字体字号，或者直接隐藏。
• 右上圆窗实时心率；趋势图可显示 15/30/60 分钟的心率、海拔、气压或身体电量。
• 天气与风向、月相、日出日落、身体电量、光照强度、强度分钟、压力、呼吸、恢复时间等。
• 深色/浅色主题，12/24 小时制，可选秒数。fēnix 6/7/8、Forerunner 245/255/955、Enduro、MARQ 等圆形 MIP 屏有专门放大的排版。
• 表盘与设置支持简体中文和英文，其他系统语言显示英文。

光照强度仅太阳能机型可用，按 Garmin「100% = 50,000 勒克斯」换算为千勒克斯显示，最高 50k；其他机型这一项显示湿度。数据由手表系统提供，缺失时显示 --，表盘不会主动开启 GPS。健康和位置数据只在手表本地读取，开发者不收集。截图为模拟器演示数据。独立开发，与 Garmin 无隶属关系。
zh_CN.whatsNew:
1.3.0
• 新增 3 种大时间字体：方角数字、数码管、点阵，共 6 种可选。
• 新增「光照强度」数据，默认显示在电量右侧，单位为千勒克斯（k）；非太阳能机型自动改为湿度。
• 全部字体按屏幕像素重新绘制，小字更清晰，不再有锯齿和粘连。
• 心率趋势图加粗加宽，刻度更易读；风向箭头默认开启。
• fēnix 6/7/8、Forerunner 等圆形屏幕布局放大约 13%，心率圆窗内移，底部数据不再贴边。
• 修复部分没有气压计的手表（如 Forerunner 55）打开表盘即退出的问题。
• 修复 Instinct 2 系列状态行百分比字体变细。

en.title: Moke · Instinct Data Watch Face, Solar & HR
en.description:
A bold black-and-white data watch face that's easy to read at a glance. Every font is drawn on your watch's pixel grid, so big numbers are sharp and small text stays clear. Free, no ads, no subscription.

• Built to save battery: no GPS, no network, no background timers, and data you are not showing is never read. The default power saver refreshes the trend chart every 5 minutes and weather every 30; seconds and heart rate can be turned down further.
• Six time styles: Current numerals, Clean, Narrow numerals, Square numerals, Seven-segment and Dot matrix. Switch on the watch or in the app.
• 29 data choices and 94 settings. Change the data, style, font and size of every field, or hide it.
• Live heart rate in the top-right window, and a trend chart for 15, 30 or 60 minutes of heart rate, altitude, air pressure or Body Battery.
• Weather and wind, moon phase, sunrise and sunset, Body Battery, solar intensity, intensity minutes, stress, respiration, recovery time and more.
• Dark or light theme, 12/24-hour time and optional seconds. Round MIP watches such as fēnix 6/7/8, Forerunner 245/255/955, Enduro and MARQ get their own larger layout.
• Watch face and settings in Simplified Chinese and English; other watch languages show English.

Solar intensity needs a solar watch. It is shown in kilolux using Garmin's 100% = 50,000 lux reference, so it tops out at 50k; other watches show humidity there instead. Data comes from your watch; missing values show --. The face never turns on GPS. Health and location data stay on the watch; the developer collects nothing. Screenshots use simulator demo data. Independently developed, not affiliated with Garmin.
en.whatsNew:
1.3.0
• Three new time styles: Square numerals, Seven-segment and Dot matrix (six in total).
• New Solar intensity data, shown next to the battery by default in kilolux (k). Watches without solar show humidity instead.
• Every font redrawn on the screen's pixel grid: sharper small text, no jagged or merged digits.
• Bolder, wider heart-rate trend chart with easier-to-read labels. Wind arrow on by default.
• Round screens on fēnix 6/7/8, Forerunner and similar watches: layout about 13% larger, heart window moved inward, footer kept clear of the edge.
• Fixed the face closing at start on some watches without a barometer, such as Forerunner 55.
• Fixed thin percentage text in the status row on Instinct 2 models.

zh_CN.title: 寰游时刻 · 复古像素世界地图表盘
zh_CN.description:
复古液晶风的世界地图表盘：数字时间、模拟小表盘、实时昼夜分界的世界地图，再加天气和日出日落。免费，无广告、无订阅。

• 轻巧省电：Venu 3 安装包只有 62 KB；持续走秒只重画秒数那一小块，超出手表电量预算会自动降级；地图缓存复用，不开 GPS、不联网。
• 6 套配色：经典、琥珀、冰川、薄荷、夜光、樱花，在 Connect IQ 应用的表盘设置里切换；彩色 AMOLED 和彩色 MIP 屏都支持，黑白屏保持高对比黑白。
• 16 种地图样式，昼夜阴影随时间变化，可显示定位点。
• 9 个数据区可自定：心率、电量、续航天数、步数、热量、距离、海拔、楼层、天气温度、日出日落、强度分钟、通知等。
• 支持的 MIP 手表可以持续走秒；AMOLED 常亮为低亮、按分钟刷新的独立显示。
• 每种屏幕按原生分辨率绘制：本能系列配合圆窗排版，其他机型小表盘为正圆，没有圆窗的机型天气区更大。
• 表盘文字为英文，设置提供简体中文和英文。

天气与位置读取系统缓存，不会主动开启 GPS；可选手动经纬度，只影响地图和日出日落。缺失数据显示 --。数据只在手表本地读取，开发者不收集。截图为模拟器演示数据。独立开发，与 Garmin 无隶属关系。
zh_CN.whatsNew:
2.2.0
• 新增 6 套配色主题（彩色 AMOLED 和彩色 MIP 屏），在表盘设置里选择。
• 彩色 MIP 屏由黑白改为彩色显示，心率、电量、海拔等标签分色。
• 没有圆窗的机型：右上小表盘改为正圆，天气区放大。
• 各机型的数字、字母和背景按原生分辨率重画，更清晰；安装包更小（Venu 3 约从 101KB 降到 62KB）。
• 修复「持续刷新」模式走一段时间后秒数停止。
• 修复日期标签与时间面板交界处的线条。

en.title: Retro World · Pixel World Map Watch Face
en.description:
A retro LCD watch face with a world map: digital time, an analogue dial and a live day-and-night map, plus weather and sunrise/sunset. Free, no ads, no subscription.

• Light and efficient: a 62 KB download on Venu 3. Continuous seconds redraw only their own corner and step down automatically if the watch’s power budget is exceeded. The map is cached; no GPS, no network.
• Six colour themes: Classic, Amber, Glacier, Mint, Night glow and Sakura. Choose one in the watch-face settings of the Connect IQ app. Works on colour AMOLED and colour MIP screens; monochrome screens stay high-contrast black and white.
• 16 map styles with day/night shading that follows the sun, and an optional location marker.
• Nine configurable data areas: heart rate, battery, battery days, steps, calories, distance, altitude, floors, temperature, sunrise/sunset, intensity minutes, notifications and more.
• Continuous seconds on supported MIP watches. AMOLED always-on uses a dim display refreshed once a minute.
• Native artwork for every screen: Instinct layouts work around the round window, other watches get a round dial and a larger weather panel.
• Watch-face text is English; settings are in English and Simplified Chinese.

Weather and location come from the watch's cache; the face never turns on GPS. Optional manual coordinates only affect the map and sun times. Missing data shows --. Data stays on the watch; the developer collects nothing. Screenshots use simulator demo data. Independently developed, not affiliated with Garmin.
en.whatsNew:
2.2.0
• Six new colour themes for colour AMOLED and colour MIP screens, chosen in the watch-face settings.
• Colour MIP screens now show colour instead of black and white, with colour-coded labels.
• Watches without a round window: the small dial is now a true circle and the weather panel is larger.
• Digits, letters and backgrounds redrawn at each watch's native resolution: sharper, and smaller downloads (Venu 3 from about 101 KB to 62 KB).
• Fixed seconds stopping after a while in continuous refresh mode.
• Fixed the line where the date tab meets the time panel.

zh_CN.title: 山境 · 雪山风景表盘 · 富士 · 珠峰
zh_CN.headline:
选一座山，
戴在腕上
zh_CN.tagline: 4 款山峰 · 每台手表不到 100 KB · 省电
zh_CN.description:
全屏山景表盘，大字时间配三栏数据。免费，无广告、无订阅。

• 4 款山峰背景：雪峰（默认）、群峰、富士、珠峰，在手表菜单或手机里切换。
• 7 个数据位，每个都能单独更换或隐藏；本能系列新增时间左侧数据位，和右侧的上下午、秒数对称。可选：步数、心率、热量、海拔、续航天数、距离、天气温度、压力、通知、日出、日落；4 种数据区样式。
• AMOLED 全彩渐变、彩色 MIP 64 色、黑白屏线稿，各自独立绘制；AMOLED 常亮为低亮移动时钟，按分钟刷新。
• 跟随系统或 12/24 小时制，抬腕显示秒数。
• 轻巧省电：每台手表的安装包都小于 100 KB，同一时间只加载一张山景；秒数只在抬腕时走，不开 GPS、不联网。

表盘菜单与设置为中英文，表盘标签为英文缩写。数据读取系统缓存，不主动开启 GPS，缺失时显示 --。健康和位置数据只在手表本地读取，开发者不收集。截图为模拟器演示数据。独立开发，与 Garmin 无隶属关系。
zh_CN.whatsNew:
1.2.0
• 新增 4 款山峰背景，默认换成全新的「雪峰」，可在设置中切换。
• 改为轻量版：每台手表的安装包小于 100KB，更省内存。移除了节日主题、多套天气/时段背景、天空装饰和日月动画；天气和日出日落数据仍可选。
• 本能系列新增「时间左侧」数据位，与右侧的上下午和秒数对称，默认关闭，可在设置中开启（来自用户建议）。
• 黑白屏数字与字母按像素重画，更清晰。
zh_CN.demoCaption: 模拟器演示数据 · 表盘菜单：英文 / 简体中文

en.title: Alpine · Mountain Watch Face · Fuji & Everest
en.headline: Pick your peak.
en.description:
A full-screen mountain watch face with bold time and three rows of data. Free, no ads, no subscription.

• Four mountain backgrounds: Summit (default), Ranges, Fuji and Everest. Switch on the watch or in the app.
• Seven data fields on every watch, each changeable or hidden; on Instinct one sits left of the time, balancing AM/PM and seconds on the right. Choose from steps, heart rate, calories, altitude, battery days, distance, temperature, stress, notifications, sunrise and sunset. Four panel styles.
• Separate artwork for full-colour AMOLED, 64-colour MIP and monochrome screens. AMOLED always-on is a dim moving clock that updates once a minute.
• System, 12- or 24-hour time, with seconds while the watch is awake.
• Light and efficient: under 100 KB on every watch, with only one mountain loaded at a time. Seconds run only while the watch is awake; no GPS, no network.

Watch menus and settings are in English and Simplified Chinese; face labels use short English abbreviations. Data comes from the watch's cache; the face never turns on GPS, and missing values show --. Health and location data stay on the watch; the developer collects nothing. Screenshots use simulator demo data. Independently developed, not affiliated with Garmin.
en.whatsNew:
1.2.0
• Four new mountain backgrounds, with a brand-new Summit as the default. Switch in settings.
• Now a lightweight edition: under 100 KB per watch, using less memory. Festival themes, the weather and time-of-day backgrounds, sky decorations and Sun/Moon animation have been removed; weather and sunrise/sunset data are still available.
• New on Instinct: an optional data field left of the time, balancing AM/PM and seconds on the right. Off by default; turn it on in settings (suggested by a user).
• Sharper pixel-drawn digits and letters on monochrome screens.
en.demoCaption: Simulator demo data · Watch menus: English / Simplified Chinese
